subject: Invoice routing and remittance update for Novara post-acquisition
messages:

Cc: Ravi Patel <legal@novara.ai>
Date: 2028-05-14T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Change of invoicing / remittance after acquisition

Hi Jonas,

As discussed on the acquisition call, Novara Systems completed its asset purchase by Aperture Holdings this week. Aperture will be centralizing payables under Aperture Holdings, Inc. effective May 1, 2028. We need Redwood to: 

- Reissue outstanding invoices for Apr 2028 and forward them to Aperture Holdings for payment.
- Update our billing name on future invoices to: "Aperture Holdings, Inc. (on behalf of Novara Systems)" with the remit address below.
- Record Aperture's VAT / tax ID and bank remittance instructions on file.

New remit details (please confirm exact invoice fields you need):
Aperture Holdings, Inc.
Attn: Treasury - Redwood Receivables
480 Meridian Ave
Richmond, CA 94801
Country: USA
VAT / TAX ID: US-98-7654321
Wire/ABA: 121000358
Account: 0987654321

We have attached the signed asset-sale statement for your records (signed-asset-sale-statement.pdf). We can also provide a signed change-of-payee form if that's your standard.

Can you confirm Redwood's required documents and an estimated timeline to have the April invoices reissued and routed to Aperture? Our close is targeting payment within 10 business days of receipt.

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Head of Finance, Novara Systems
finance@novara.ai

Subject: Re: Change of invoicing / remittance after acquisition

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the attachment. Congratulations on closing.

Quick confirmation from our side: we can reissue Apr 2028 invoices to Aperture and update the billing name, but finance will need a few items to complete the record and for audit: 

1) Signed change-of-payee or remittance authorization (DocuSign OK).
2) Confirmation of Aperture's legal entity (EIN / tax ID) + proof of ownership/asset transfer (you included the asset sale statement which helps).
3) Bank remittance details (we'll validate the ABA/account).
4) If Aperture has a different invoice recipient email and AP person, please share.

Grace — can you pick this up and outline the reissue timeline and any internal approvals? Marissa, loop in legal if you need to review the asset statement or the change-of-payee language.

Emily — once we have the signed form and bank details, we generally reissue invoices within 3–7 business days and flag them as "reissued per acquisition". I'll provide the HubSpot record and DocuSign link in my next email.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0110

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Change of invoicing / remittance after acquisition — action plan

On it. Drafting a short checklist for finance ops and AP to execute. Key items below — please confirm if I should request any additional evidence from Novara/Aperture before we reissue: 

- Required from client: signed change-of-payee (DocuSign link), Aperture EIN (tax ID), AP contact + remit email, bank remittance details.
- Validation steps: verify asset-sale-statement matches the entity names; match EIN to Aperture filings (US PTO / state registry); test wire routing with a $1.00 micro-transfer if bank routing looks mismatched.
- Accounting treatment: create a new billing alias under "Aperture Holdings (Novara)"; copy all open invoices to new alias and mark originals as reissued; include "Reissued for acquisition - original inv #" in invoice memo.
- VAT/tax: since this is US-based, VAT doesn't apply, but keep VAT field populated for EU customers. Ask client to confirm tax residency if they have EU subsidiaries.
- Timeline: once signed form + bank details received, target 5 business days to reissue and submit to Aperture AP.

I attached our billing-change form (redwood-billing-change-form.xlsx) — this is the minimal set we need signed. I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope today and will include the HubSpot deal ID.

Marissa — please confirm if legal needs to approve the wording in the change-of-payee before I send DocuSign.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Finance Ops Manager
redwood.finance@redwood.com

--- attachment: redwood-billing-change-form.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <finance@novara.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Liam Chen <acq-ops@apertureholdings.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Change of invoicing / remittance after acquisition — next steps and DocuSign

Emily / Liam — looping in Aperture AP contact so we have the right recipient.

Per Grace's checklist, here's what we need to proceed: 

1) A signed copy of the attached change-of-payee form (we'll send via DocuSign).
2) Aperture's EIN (tax ID) and AP contact email (if different from acq-ops@apertureholdings.com).
3) Bank remittance details for routing validation.

I've prepared the DocuSign envelope here: https://redwood.app/docusign/7890 — please sign the redwood-billing-change-form. Once signed and we validate the bank info, we will: 

- Reissue Apr 2028 invoices to "Aperture Holdings, Inc. (on behalf of Novara Systems)" and mark originals as reissued.
- Send reissued invoices to aperture.ap@apertureholdings.com (or confirmed AP contact).
- Flag the HubSpot deal HS-45678 to indicate reissued invoices and expected payment window.

Estimated timeline: we expect to complete the reissue within 5 business days of receiving the signed form + validated bank details. If Aperture requires vendor onboarding docs (W9, vendor form), let us know and we'll supply Redwood vendor packet.

Emily — can you confirm the AP contact and sign the DocuSign by EOD May 18 so we can meet Aperture's 10-business-day payment target?

Thanks and congrats again on the close — happy to make this transition smooth.

Best,
Jonas
